book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Eti wo lei ngandoung eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei
Lek bouk kayon eno xel betiyeing lam wou Yesu me teling, “Eti wo lei ngandoung eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei?”
Moxo taxe yak tika me wong e nale eivek xel senghoing.
De neil, “A neil wou xam zonghek, wangwei xam se pekwi me ghe ghok ambei yak kane, on tyek xam seng teyei bei na eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yo.
Nambei nyon, eti yeiw wei mi beoux xow nambei yak kane eno wo lei ngandoung eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei.
“Me eti yeiw wei qou yak ambei nye eivek a leing, eno qou ay.
Enok tambiy ti bong yak ti beimambei wei wongis a ne detei en sewokeing, ond inye teyei bei xel banoux qakous ngandoung lek e kwa dom banex e deteina heivek mamileeng me e mey.
“Inye lalei pyaweing en xomaxoneing wei tembuing ne eno mi wong xel amba mi tei en sewokeing. Zonghek, lul nilul ambei nyon eno tyek nam, ekom tambiy wei wong inyon tyip eno e gyaleeng!

Om wangwei wa memam o wa vaxam na toung wang eivek sewokeing, ond qateiv veil me nex e la. Inye nimza bei wang na eivek mapieing luta luta is memam tixemou o vaxam tixemou, enok wa memam yuw o vaxam yuw ekom xel banex wang na eivek nenyex wei luta luta yo.

Me wangwei wa mamghalus na toung wang eivek sewokeing, ond qepei e lam myayaing me nex e la. Inye nimza bei wang na mendei mapieing is mamghalus tixemou enok wa mamghalus yuw ekom xel banex wang na eivek nenyex wei luta luta yo.
Qayeeng pakeing wei sipsip lati yo
“Xam ghe gweiteyei en kandek xam se neimbei yakyak ambei inye lul bandaing. En a neil wou xam bei xel xe angela eivek tyoung gheyapu nei eno mi yei Mang wei tyoung gheyapu nei manghalus.
[En Xomaxoneing Neu Moux lam bei qou eti yeiw wei lati yo noum.]
“Wang wou naleim ambei nya? Wangwei tambiy ti xe sipsip teyei lek 100, ekom ti nati, yond tyek moxo se teyei bei ghanaw 99 on lek qetyei dom na gyimexe tiwei lati yo?
De wangwei e gyeiwou nei, a neil wou xam zonghek, moxo tyek bo xeilala en tiwei lati yo de se 99 wei se lati yo.
Eivek sakwaing ambei nyon eno Mam wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu embei yakyak on ti se nati.
Wa lim wei wo sewokeing wou wang o
“Wangwei lim bo sewokeing wou wang, ond eivek muw venaxow senghoing eno la me neil e xe nilul teyei wou e. Wangwei e ngowou wa xe qayeeng, yon nambei wang qou lim loum.
Ekom wangwei e se ngowou nei, yon wa qou tambiy ti o yuw is xow, en kandek ‘pavulek tambak wei moux yuw o yal eno na byexaxoun qayeeng.’
Wangwei e bei se ngowou xel xe qayeeng, yon wa neil wou kongrikesin dalus. Ek wangwei e pyalek kongrikesin xe qayeeng, ond xam ghe gwei e bei inyon tambiy wei mandalus o tambiy wei mi qou takis o ti.
“A neil wou xam zonghek, vatiyeiw wei xam ghe tup lek tembuing eno tyek Anutu na tup eivek tyoung gheyapu, de vatiyeiw wei xam ghe tul lek tembuing eno tyek Anutu na tul veil eivek tyoung gheyapu.
“A neil wou xam no bei, wangwei xam on yuw na toung laleimim lekti en vati wei muw ambei teling en eno tyek Mang wei tyoung gheyapu nei bong wou muw.
En wangwei muw yuw o mal yal a being nam qeku lekti eivek a leing, inyon a toundei is mal.”
Qayeeng pakeing en xukxe wei lalei pyaweing ma veil e yo
Woyom Petele lam wou Yesu me teling, “Tambiy Ngandoung, teyei lek lu vamva eno a teyei bei semaleeng ling xe nilul gyeik ingwei embo sewokeing wou ay yo? Ena teyei lek lim yuw?”
Yesu neil elox, “A neil wou wang, se lu lim yuw, qe teyei lek lu lim yuw me e mi na lumama teyei lek 70.
“Nambei nyon, tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno inye nambei king ti embei menyex wou malew vateivek is e xe xel xukxe wei xel qou wou e yo.
Ka moxo qandi en menyex wou malew vateivek, moxo taxe tambiy wei qou malew 10,000 eno lam wou e.
Ekom moxo se teyei bei bong malew zeyi, om teiv wo qayeeng nikanzek bei xel bong vateivek lek lis venei neu me lulul dalus wei e beeng o de bong ena zeyi malew vateivek wei qou yo.
“Xukxe ev vaxa qatu eivek atax wou e me tay, ‘Wam di daxe ay, en tyek a bong lulul dalus nouk wou wang.’
Teiv wei xukxe yon pyanalei en e, om semaleeng malew vateivek wei qou yo dom wong e la.
“Ekom xukxe tiyon la myayaing, moxo yeiwou e xe laxous tiwei luw mi wo xuk lekti yo wei qou malew 100 wou e yo. Moxo sex e kwa de luk nikanzek wou e, ‘Wang bong vati wei wang qou wou ay eno noum!’
“Moxo xe laxous wei luw mi wong xuk lekti eno ev vaxa qatu eivek me tay wou e, ‘Wam di daxe ay, en tyek a bong malew vateivek wei a qou eno nouk zeyi wou wang.’
“Ekom moxo se lewexe lek. Qe la veil de toung laxous la eivek xeitueing deka embong malew vateivek wei qou yo noum zeyi le.
Woyom laxousyeiw valu yei vati wei belup on eno xel laleind wo myavanei ngandoung. Om xel la neil wou xel xe teiv en lul sapa wei belup on.
“Woyom teiv taxe xukxe la lalei me neil, ‘Wa xukxe nilul ayang. A semaleeng wa xe malew vateivek dalus wei wang o, en nambei wang tay wou ay.
Se teyei bei wa pyanaleim en laxous nge wei muw ghe mi wo xuk o nambei ingwei a wong wou wang o?’
Teiv moxo lalei wo vanei wou e om toung e la wou xel belimbo wei xeitueing o bei xel bong vanei wou e, deka e bong lulul dalus wei e qou yo noum bole.
“Tine inye Mang wei tyoung gheyapu nei tyek bong wou xam titi yo, wangwei wa se semaleeng nilul wei limyeiw nge wong wou wang eivek laleim o.”

footnotes.text: Petieing 19:15 qayeeng veweeng eno neil ambei nye, “Pavulek tambak wei moux yuw o yal eno na byexaxoun qayeeng.”
